subject: util/ranger: do not convert to binary collate for string values when `convertToSortKey` is `false` (#51363)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent. The change gates `convertStringFTToBinaryCollate()` behind `convertToSortKey`, so partition pruning (`DetachCondAndBuildRangeForPartition(..., convertToSortKey=false)`) no longer forces string datums to binary collation during `points2Ranges` casting, which previously broke key partition hashing/pruning because `Datum.ToHashKey()` is collation-sensitive. Added integration coverage for issue #51316 on KEY partition + `utf8mb4_general_ci`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner/ranger/partition-pruning call chain.
